name: BMad Method
summary: Agile AI-driven development method: agent skills and workflows that turn an idea or change request into reviewed software.
description: A method plus installable skills for AI coding tools: it right-sizes planning to the change (small changes go straight to build, complex work gets deeper planning), keeps product and technical decisions as durable context, and works through product, architecture, UX, development and testing perspectives. Official modules add a builder, creative intelligence, enterprise test architecture, an unattended epic loop and game dev; install via the skills CLI or Claude Code / Codex plugin marketplaces.
